action.response: OK, cancelled. Ask a question, or say help.

pre.response:
Welcome to Knowledge Discovery chat.
Ask me a question and I will search your KD databases, then I am ready for the next thing — another question, or a task.

Try help, what databases, or just ask.

regex.pattern: ^(?:start again|start over|reset(?: chat)?|back to(?: the)? beginning)\s*[.!?]?$
^(?:help|options|what can you do|how (?:do I|to) use this)\s*[?!.]?$
^(?:what|which|list|show|available)\s+(?:are\s+the\s+)?(?:the\s+)?(?:data\s*bases?|dbs?|knowledge\s+bases?)\b.*$|^(?:what can you search|what do you know)\s*[?!.]?$

requirements.prompt: {{session:DATABASE_LIST_PROMPT}}Which database should I search? Say a name, several names, or all.

post.response: I'll search {{session:SELECTED_DATABASE_LABEL}} from now on. Ask a question whenever you're ready.

regex.pattern: \b(?:use database|change database|select database|choose database|refine(?: my)? search|search only in)\b

pre.response: Searching all databases again. Ask a question whenever you're ready.

regex.pattern: ^(?:search all(?: databases)?|all databases|use all databases|reset databases)\s*[.!?]?$
